message.text:
h13.

**`*markdown.service` (the only implementation) — constructed once by `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`, reached from `server/server.go:76` — held by `APIV1Service`, `RSSService`, and `memopayload.Runner`**

The interface is `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`), with eight methods spanning extraction (`ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`), rendering (`RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`), validation, and `RenameTag`.

Exactly one type implements it: the unexported `service` struct at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60`, which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown`. A search for `ExtractAll` method declarations across the repo returns a single hit (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`), so there is no second implementation and no test double satisfying the interface — tests call the real `NewService`. Note that `NewService` returns the interface type rather than the concrete pointer (line 85), which is why the concrete type stays unexported.

Construction in production happens in one place, inside `NewAPIV1Service`:

```48:51:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
```

Both custom extensions are enabled here, on top of GitHub Flavored Markdown and auto heading IDs configured inside `NewService` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:91-108`). That matters because the options are off by default — `markdown.NewService()` with no arguments produces a service that will not parse `#tags` or `@mentions`. `NewAPIV1Service` is itself called at `server/server.go:76`, so this single instance is created during startup.

Three components hold the interface, and all share that one instance:

- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), used for memo payload rebuilds (`memo_service.go:108`, `:447`), mention extraction (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32`), and webhook snippets (`memo_service_webhooks.go:85`).
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), used to render feed HTML at `rss.go:339`. It is injected rather than freshly constructed — `server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `NewRSSService`, so the RSS feed inherits the same tag/mention configuration.
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), plus the package-level function `RebuildMemoPayload`, which takes a `markdown.Service` parameter directly (`runner.go:74`). The `Runner` struct is never constructed in production, so in practice this holder is exercised only through the parameter form called by the API service.

One thing to flag: two other sites do build their own instances, but only in tests — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427` (tags only) and `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`. The `fileserver` and `mcp` services do not hold the interface at all.
